# GUI Interface Description

## System Top Bar
- **Left Side**: "Activities" button
- **Center**: "Files" application icon with a dropdown menu
- **Right Side**:
  - Date and time: "Oct 22 21:30"
  - Notification bell icon
  - System status icons (network, sound, power)

## Dropdown Menu from "Files" Icon
- **Menu Items**:
  - "New Window"
  - "Quit"

## File Manager Window
- **Window Title Bar**:
  - "Files" application name
  - Minimize, Maximize, Close buttons
- **Navigation Toolbar**:
  - View options: List view, Grid view, and other view controls
  - Search icon
- **Left Sidebar Navigation**:
  - "Recent"
  - "Starred"
  - "Home" (currently selected)
  - "Desktop"
  - "Documents"
  - "Downloads"
  - "Music"
  - "Pictures"
  - "Videos"
  - "Trash"
  - "Other Locations"
- **Main Content Area**:
  - Grid of files and folders
  - Folder icons with labels:
    - Desktop
    - Documents
    - Downloads
    - Music
    - Pictures
    - Public
    - server
    - snap
    - Templates
    - Videos
    - .cache
    - .config
    - .gnupg
    - .ipython
    - .bash_history
    - .bash_logout
    - .bashrc
    - .local
    - .mozilla
    - .pki
    - .profile
    - .selected_editor
    - .ssh
    - .sudo_as_admin_successful
    - thunderbird
    - .var
    - .viminfo
    - .vscode
  - File icon with label: "requirement.txt"

## Desktop Environment
- **Left Dock**:
  - Application icons:
    - Google Chrome
    - Thunderbird
    - Visual Studio Code
    - VLC Media Player
    - LibreOffice Writer
    - LibreOffice Calc
    - LibreOffice Impress
    - GIMP
    - Terminal
    - Trash
    - Software Center
    - Help
    - System Settings
  - Grid icon for application launcher

## Browser Window (Google Chrome)
- **Browser Tabs**:
  - "New Tab" (active)
- **Address Bar**:
  - Search bar with placeholder text
  - Star icon
  - User profile icon
  - Notification: "New Chrome available"
- **Navigation Buttons**:
  - Minimize, Maximize, Close buttons
- **Browser Content**:
  - Google homepage with logo
  - Search bar with microphone and camera icons
  - "Add shortcut" button
  - "Customise Chrome" button in bottom right corner
- **Top Right**:
  - "Gmail" and "Images" links
  - Grid icon for Google apps

## System Status Icons
- Located in top right corner of the screen
- Includes network, sound, and power icons

## Window Management
- File manager window is in foreground
- Browser window is partially visible behind the file manager window
- Both windows have standard window controls (minimize, maximize, close)
